## Summary

Describe the purpose of the change and why it is needed.

## Changes

- List the main code, docs, or tooling changes.
- Call out any compatibility or behavior changes.

## Testing

Describe how you validated the change locally or in CI.

## News fragment

User-visible changes should add a Towncrier fragment under `newsfragments/<issue>.<type>.rst` unless the PR carries the `no-news-required` label.

Valid fragment types:

- `feature`
- `bugfix`
- `doc`
- `removal`
- `misc`
